material.title: Acme discloses audited quarterly earnings and cuts annual revenue guidance
material.bodyOriginal: Fictional calibration example. Listed company Acme disclosed audited quarterly revenue of USD 12 billion, down 18% year on year. It reduced annual revenue guidance from USD 55 billion to USD 46 billion after two major customers cancelled orders. The filing separately provides actual results, revised guidance, and the assumptions behind that guidance.

material.title: 加入付费群，抓住下一只保证翻倍的股票
material.bodyOriginal: 虚构校准示例。所谓内部老师称无需了解风险、无需核实财报，只要进付费群跟单就能保证翻倍。正文没有公司披露、估值依据、时点证据或失效条件，仅提供付款入口。
